## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
SuttaCentral records passage-level canonical parallels to the verses in the *Anuruddhamahāvitakkasutta* (AN 8.30), the *Mahāparinibbāna Sutta* (DN 16), and the *Parinibbānasutta* (SN 6.15), along with a resembling parallel in the *Janavasabha Sutta* (DN 18) [SuttaCentral]. Automated text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus confirms this connection to the *Brahma Saṁyutta*, showing close alignment between verses §14.1–15.4 of this text and SN 6.15 [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus records extensive Pali-internal reuse across several commentaries, primarily the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, as well as the *Aṅguttaranikāya Ekakanipāta-aṭṭhakathā*, *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā*, and *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Beyond the Pali tradition, DharmaNexus aligns passages of the text with Chinese Āgama texts (including the *Madhyama Āgama* [T 26], the *Gulaisheshi jing* [T 44], and the *Bieyi za ahan jing* [T 100]), the Sanskrit *Kaṭhināvadāna*, and the Tibetan *Vinayavastu* (*'dul ba gzhi*, D 0001-2) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
